svg.title: DIA-205 · Three signs before the bridge
svg.desc: A road-safety poster in flat colour. A pale road runs up from the foreground, bends right and crosses a river on a bridge whose middle span has fallen. Fresh tyre tracks follow the road past three signs and stop at the broken edge, and rings spread on the water below. The first sign is a warning triangle almost swallowed by a roadside tree. The second is a board that reads PLEASE CONSIDER SLOWING. The third, in rust at the bridge approach, reads BRIDGE CERTIFIED SAFE, with a small plate beneath: inspected by its builder.
svg.text: PART II · VISIBILITY, RULES, AND RULE-MAKERS
DIA-205 · A hidden warning, a polite request and a builder's own certificate: none of them stops the car.
